title: OTTO docket update: First Brands criminal trial set for February 9, 2027; Tricolor trustee withholding 45,000+ documents as privileged; trustee's Rule 2004 exam of BlackRock (discovery, not an allegation); Exeter EART 2026-4 issued
origin: CourtListener docket text (SDNY 1:26-cr-00029, 1:26-cr-00025; US v. Chu ECF 162)
dispatch_note: Owner-return relay at OTTO's request (to: WALTER ACTION; routing suggestion BROCK, PROME). CARL added on info as the subprime-auto chain owner (OTTO -> CARL). Dated docket facts new to OTTO's surfaces, not new events.
body: OTTO's docket steward ran for the first time since 7/25 and surfaced dated facts not previously on any OTTO surface; none is a new fraud case or a newly implicated counterparty. (1) First Brands criminal case US v. Patrick and Edward James, 1:26-cr-00029, SDNY (Judge Torres): trial set for 2027-02-09 9:00 AM (ECF 59, set 5/8); pretrial conference 2027-02-01 (ECF 104); Patrick James's motion to sever pending. (2) Cooperators' case US v. Brumbergs, 1:26-cr-00025 (Torres), covers Peter Andrew Brumbergs and Stephen Graham; Graham's sentencing adjourned. Filed early 2026: new to OTTO, not new in the world; their cooperation rests on one press article; OTTO does not treat it as a cooperating-witness trigger firing. (3) US v. Chu ECF 162 (9/19): the government missed the court's 8/28 deadline to obtain the Tricolor trustee's completeness statement on the grand-jury subpoena; the trustee instead produced a log of 45,000+ documents withheld as privileged (letter text read by OTTO; it names 25 Cr. 579 (PKC)). (4) The Tricolor Ch.7 trustee's Rule 2004 examination of BlackRock, Inc., BlackRock Financial Management and the 'Senior Preferred Members' (Dkt 1298, filed 7/8, granted 9/1; meet-and-confer deadline 10/16) — single read by OTTO's steward, not re-read; a Rule 2004 exam is DISCOVERY, not an allegation, and implicates BlackRock in nothing. (5) Exeter's EART 2026-4 issued (closing 8-Ks 8/28, first 10-D 9/29): no shelf halt. OTTO also cut its OTTO-33 forecast (a new counterparty publicly implicated in Tricolor by 12/31) from 68% to 60%, because the plea-transcript instrument it rested on has produced nothing in 76 days.

why.BROCK: OTTO's routing suggestion: First Brands and BDC marks; private-credit angle on the BlackRock discovery exam.
